Stop jumping rope like this. Both feet, big jump, pause on every landing.

It's more pounding on your knees, less speed, and you gas out fast.

Skip it like a boxer. One foot at a time, low and quick, like running in place. In this clip I'm at about 155 steps a minute.

Save this for your next cardio day and send it to the guy at your gym who jumps like a kangaroo.

#over40 #jumprope #fitnessover40 #homeworkout #fatloss

6 weeks of crunches. Zero belly fat lost. 7 ab exercises, 5 days a week.

Ab endurance went up. Belly fat didn't change compared with the group that skipped ab work. Vispute et al., Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research, 2011.

At 38 I was 200 lb doing hundreds of crunches. I saw none of them.

Abs are a body-fat number, not a rep count.

Save this for the next time someone tells you to do 100 crunches a day.

#over40 #sixpackabs #fatloss #abworkout #fitnessover40

3 moves. 3 minutes. No gym. 1 minute on each move.

Spiderman plank: knee to the same side elbow, keep your hips level, alternate sides.

Toe touch crunch: legs straight up, reach for your shoes, and lower slowly.

Plank up-down: forearms to hands one arm at a time, hips square, and switch your lead arm.

Screenshot this, do it tonight, and tag the friend who says he has no time.

#homeworkout #abworkout #over40 #fitnessover40 #sixpackabs
